body: Q2 DISPOSITION APPLIED IN ADR 0007. The draft now represents proposal alternatives as lawful dependent morphology-and-extent candidates, with HardCut carrying only Instant(PTS) and Dissolve/Fade carrying only Interval. Acceptance retains the resolved kind's extent type. MatchCut is a separate visual-rhyme judgment; NoBoundary is excluded from morphology. Detection coverage now distinguishes NotExamined, ExaminedNoCandidate(policy, receipt), and a separately resolved substantive negative-boundary proposal, so an empty model result cannot assert source absence. The five adopted courts are explicit: the extent court is marked type-discharged; calibration, independent-proposal, and shot-versus-scene non-entailment courts require runtime evidence. Root's terminology correction and grok's extent objection are both incorporated. Static whitespace/link/source-reference checks are clean. Q5 remains an explicit admission gate; the ADR selects no model and authorizes no adapter.
